entities.name: NOTIFICATION
entities.description: Message sent by the network to inform the UE about events relevant for upper layers using an EPS bearer context or having requested a procedure transaction.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE receives the NOTIFICATION message from the network.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network sends the NOTIFICATION message to the UE.

entities.name: EPS Bearer Context
entities.description: Upper layers may use an EPS bearer context when events relevant to them occur.

entities.name: Procedure Transaction
entities.description: Upper layers may have requested a procedure transaction when events relevant to them occur.

relations.description: The network sends the NOTIFICATION message to the UE.
The NOTIFICATION message is received by the UE.
The NOTIFICATION message informs about events relevant for upper layers using an EPS bearer context.
The NOTIFICATION message informs about events relevant for upper layers having requested a procedure transaction.
